content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The traditional platforms like Gumroad and Payhip charge hefty fees, with Gumroad taking 10% on every sale. In contrast, NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5%, retaining $921 of your earnings at 100 sales per month on a $97 product. This infrastructure works because it's built on open-source tools and crypto payments, giving you full ownership and control over your store, without relying on restrictive platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to gather a few essential tools. You'll require a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. Additionally, you'll need to set up a crypto payment processor like NOWPayments to handle transactions.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership and control over your digital store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows, you can scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, providing you with the tools needed to expand your store and increase sales. By leveraging crypto payments and open-source tools, you can create a scalable and sustainable digital commerce stack that adapts to your growing business
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Crypto payments provide a low-fee alternative to traditional platforms.

This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, providing everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more and start selling your digital products with crypto today.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, start by setting up your hosting platform, then configure your backend logic and storage solutions. Next, integrate NOWPayments with your store and establish a delivery mechanism. Finally, go live and start processing transactions, and as you grow, scale your infrastructure using the Complete Builder Kit. With these steps, you'll be well on your way to creating a thriving digital commerce store.
